page: Microsoft Azure E16ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The system configuration includes 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading operating at clock speeds up to 4.5 GHz. The platform is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is provided through a 944 GB NVMe solid-state drive, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization hypervisor. Architectural processor extensions include AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and cryptographic accelerators including AES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier single-thread capabilities paired with solid mid-tier multi-core execution. The processor achieves top-decile performance in stress-ng single-core tests, Geekbench single-core scoring at 2767.0, and single-threaded gzip and bzip3 compression. Multi-threaded performance settles in the middle tier, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 15221.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 32237.46. Large-block uncached memory bandwidth yields 51.3 GB/sec for reads and 34.09 GB/sec for writes. Small language model inference displays strong prompt and generation speed, though large parameter models experience significant execution latency due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.

The hardware configuration provides strong resource balance for environments requiring extensive memory capacity alongside fast single-core throughput. The integrated 944 GB local NVMe disk accommodates fast local caching and temporary data sets without external storage overhead. Primary workloads supported by this profile include in-memory databases, Redis key-value stores, complex software builds, ETL data pipelines, and analytical backend services.
description: Microsoft Azure E16ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating up to 4.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128.0 GB of RAM, adhering to an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside a bundled 944 GB local NVMe SSD for fast transient storage. Benchmark testing shows top-tier single-core performance, verified by high scores in Geekbench and single-threaded compression, while multi-core metrics and memory bandwidth align within mid-tier averages. With support for AVX-512 extensions and cryptographic instructions, the processor handles intensive computational operations efficiently without requiring GPU hardware. The instance delivers balanced cost efficiency for memory-heavy services that benefit from fast single-thread throughput and low-latency local storage. It is well matched for in-memory databases, Redis caches, analytical processing, and mid-sized backend enterprise applications.
